name: Sniper Assassin 5: Final Mission
author: Addicting Games
description: Sniper Assassin 5: Final Mission is a free sniper game. It’s been a rough few months for old Shawn, but the end is finally in sight in this puzzle/action game. Shawn’s in deep at this point, and it’s up to you to help see him through this ordeal. In this final chapter of the Sniper Assassin saga, you’re chasing down the man responsible for everything in a series of puzzle-based sniper scenarios. Will he pay for what he’s done, or will he only be making a fool out of poor old Shawn?
